notes: Coop setting. Agent = CooperBench's own coop agent (two mini-swe-agent v2 agents at upstream commit 63b9d44, coop.yaml, step limit 100, messaging on, git off), vendored in the adapter as cooperbench_autoadapter.coop_agent:CooperBenchCoopAgent. Model openai/deepseek-v4.1-flash through the same OpenAI-compatible endpoint on both sides; every response was served by deepseek-v4-1-flash-261017. Parity set: 15 of 652 pairs (--split parity), stratified by repository, seed 42. Harbor 0.25.0 on Daytona (4 CPUs / 12 GB per pair, typst 8 / 16); original side: fork commit eb271c8 on Daytona, one pair at a time per 4-CPU / 12-GB sandbox. Metric: pass rate in % (both features' tests pass on the merged patches). Runs 2 and 3 ran at the same time on both sides. Oracle: 652/652. Standard agent check: Claude Code 2.1.311 with the same model, one agent for both features, 11/15 (one run).
